author: Shivam Kumar

excerpt: Buying an under-construction flat in New Gurgaon (Sector 76-95)? Here's exactly what interior decisions to make before possession, and why timing matters.
keyTakeaways: Raise Layout Changes 9-12 Months Before Possession — While MEP work is still in progress and builders can accommodate requests.
Freeze Design 6-9 Months Before Possession — So procurement runs in parallel with construction rather than starting after handover.
Order Long-Lead Items Early — Custom furniture and imported fittings can take 8-16 weeks to produce.
Zone Extra Rooms Deliberately — Larger New Gurgaon carpet areas call for early decisions on home office, media room, or guest suite use.
Execution After Possession Takes 75-100 Days — Achievable when design and procurement are already complete at handover.
contentHtml:
If you've booked an under-construction flat in New Gurgaon — the corridor spanning Sector 76 through Sector 95, developed by builders including DLF, Emaar, Pyramid Infratech, Suncity, and Corona — the interior decisions that matter most (electrical layout, plumbing points, any structural modification requests) need to be finalised 6-12 months before possession, while the builder can still accommodate them.

New Gurgaon has become one of the city's most active construction corridors, with projects like DLF Privana South and Privana West, Whiteland The Aspen, and Whiteland Blissville currently under construction across sectors 76-95.

Why New Gurgaon's Under-Construction Stage Is a Genuine Planning Opportunity

  • Time to plan without pressure — finalise design, palette, and budget over months rather than compressing decisions into weeks after possession.
  • A chance to influence what's built in — some builders allow limited customisation requests (modular kitchen provisioning, additional electrical points, plumbing line adjustments) if raised early enough.
  • Parallel procurement — long-lead items (custom furniture, imported fittings) can be ordered in advance.

What to Decide Before Possession, and When

12-9 Months Before — Layout & Structural Decisions

Raise any wall/plumbing/electrical-affecting layout change with your builder now, while MEP work is in progress.

9-6 Months Before — Design Freeze & Material Selection

Finalise kitchen layout, wardrobe design, false ceiling, flooring, palette based on the confirmed floor plan. Place long-lead custom orders (8-16 week lead times).

6-2 Months Before — Procurement & Vendor Coordination

Modular kitchen fabrication, wardrobe carcasses, and furniture production, timed to be ready to install at possession.

Possession to Move-In — Execution

With design/procurement complete, bare-shell execution typically takes 75-100 days.

What Makes New Gurgaon's Building Stock Different From Established Corridors

  • Larger carpet areas call for zoning decisions early — decide room functions (home office, media room, guest suite) at the design stage rather than defaulting extra rooms to "spare bedroom." Our 4BHK interior design guide covers this zoning question in more depth.
  • Modern MEP provisioning is usually better, but still needs verification — provisions vary project to project.
  • Township-level amenities shift some design priorities indoors — with clubhouses/pools handled at society level, interior budgets can lean more toward core living spaces.

faqs.question: When should I start interior design planning for an under-construction New Gurgaon flat?
faqs.answer: Start structural/layout conversations 9-12 months before expected possession; freeze design 6-9 months before, so procurement runs in parallel with construction.

faqs.question: Can I request layout changes in an under-construction New Gurgaon project?
faqs.answer: Some builders allow limited requests if raised early in the construction timeline, through the customer relations team.

faqs.question: How long does interior execution take after possession in New Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: 75-100 days for a bare-shell 3BHK or 4BHK with design/procurement already completed.

faqs.question: Which builders are currently active in New Gurgaon's Sector 76-95 corridor?
faqs.answer: DLF, Emaar, Pyramid Infratech, Suncity, and Corona, spanning under-construction and ready-to-move projects.

faqs.question: Should I order my modular kitchen before or after possession in New Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Before — order once design is frozen against the confirmed floor plan, so it's ready to install at possession.
